subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main WSL2 or Docker reproduction of the session.scope="global" plus dmScope="per-channel-peer" heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection strongly supports the reporter's hypothesis, but changing global session routing is compatibility-sensitive and the issue is already marked for maintainer review/live repro.

options.title: Run live repro first

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
